predecessors.name: Vijayanagara Empire
predecessors.text: Keladi and Ikkeri, in present-day Shimoga district

successors.name: Kingdom of Mysore
successors.text: much of the Malnad and most of the Kanara coast incl.

successors.name: Kingdom of Coorg
successors.text: Haleri kingdom of Coorg, founded by a Keladi family member

ledger.x: 1499: Chaudappa Nayaka founds the Keladi Nayaka dynasty in the Shimoga Malnad.
1645: Shivappa Nayaka's campaigns widen the kingdom over the Kanara coast and Malnad, to its greatest extent (c.
1763: Hyder Ali defeats the Keladi queen Virammaji and absorbs the kingdom into Mysore.

certainty.note: Page gives no boundaries or area; modern districts stand in.
